DEMO CONTENT written by the builder: not pre-tested, merit tiers set by the builder (P1 rates them), Hinglish a draft. Counts, tie structures, which characters carry which cue, and every threshold the rating uses are PENDING v18. Consequence lines are equal in valence (candidates v17 3.17): different in content, never in success, keyed by the merit tier of the lead's notes, never by who carried them.

premise.en: Five episodes in a busy warehouse, from the hiring sprint to the season close.
premise.hinglish: Ek vyast warehouse mein paanch episodes, hiring sprint se season ke ant tak.

intro.en: You lead a team of eight at Kite Logistics, a made-up warehouse company near Pune. The season runs in five episodes, with the same team throughout, and with applicants, vendors and other people passing through.
intro.hinglish: Aap Kite Logistics mein aath logon ki team lead karte hain, Pune ke paas ek kaalpanik warehouse company. Season paanch episodes mein chalta hai, poore samay wahi team, aur beech mein applicants, vendors aur doosre log aate jaate hain.

intro.en: Each screen is one decision. What you decide shows up on the next screen.
intro.hinglish: Har screen ek decision hai. Aapka decision agli screen par dikhta hai.

intro.en: To put colleagues in order, tap them, first choice first. The last one fills itself in.
intro.hinglish: Colleagues ko order mein rakhne ke liye unhe tap kijiye, pehli pasand pehle. Aakhri apne aap bhar jaata hai.

intro.en: To share something out, tap a number for each colleague.
intro.hinglish: Kuch baantne ke liye har colleague ke liye ek number tap kijiye.

intro.en: Changed your mind? Use Back on the next screen.
intro.hinglish: Mann badal gaya? Agli screen par Back dabaiye.

body.en: You meet the team in person. Here is who was who on the team chat.
body.hinglish: Aap team se khud milte hain. Team chat par kaun kaun tha, yeh raha.

scene.en: Lotus Home wants a first plan for its big sale by Friday.
scene.hinglish: Lotus Home ko apni badi sale ka pehla plan Friday tak chahiye.

question.en: Who should draft the peak plan? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Peak plan kaun likhega? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Wrote the peak plans for two clients last year; both were signed off first time.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal do clients ke peak plan likhe; dono pehli baar mein approve hue.

text.en: Drafted last year's year-end plan; the client approved it without changes.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal ka year-end plan likha; client ne bina badlaav approve kiya.

text.en: Has reviewed plans for others; not yet written one alone.
text.hinglish: Doosron ke plans review kiye hain; akele abhi tak koi nahin likha.

text.en: New to client plans; strong on spreadsheets, still learning how plans are set out.
text.hinglish: Client plans mein naya; spreadsheet mein mazboot, plan ka format abhi seekhna baaki.

3.en: {name} sent the plan on Friday. Lotus Home's first question is about delivery slots.
3.hinglish: {name} ne Friday ko plan bheja. Lotus Home ka pehla sawaal delivery slots par hai.

1.en: {name} sent the plan on Friday. Lotus Home's first question is about staffing.
1.hinglish: {name} ne Friday ko plan bheja. Lotus Home ka pehla sawaal staffing par hai.

scene.en: Two shifts each say the other missed a handover. Four colleagues give an account.
scene.hinglish: Do shifts ek doosre par handover chhodne ka aarop lagati hain. Chaar colleagues bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Aap kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Was at the handover and logged it in the shift book the same hour.
text.hinglish: Handover par maujood the aur usi ghante shift book mein likha.

text.en: Saw the handover and kept the scanner printout from it.
text.hinglish: Handover dekha aur uska scanner printout rakha.

text.en: Arrived after the handover and heard about it later.
text.hinglish: Handover ke baad pahunche aur baad mein suna.

text.en: Was off site that day and read about it in the chat.
text.hinglish: Us din site par nahin the aur chat mein padha.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the handover review, which starts from the shift book.
3.hinglish: Handover review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, shift book se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the handover review, which starts from the chat messages.
1.hinglish: Handover review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, chat messages se.

scene.en: The team's first video call is on Thursday.
scene.hinglish: Team ki pehli video call Thursday ko hai.

question.en: Snacks for the first team call?
question.hinglish: Pehli team call ke liye snacks?

text.en: Send each person a small snack box
text.hinglish: Har vyakti ko ek chhota snack box bhejein

after.en: The snack boxes arrive on Thursday morning. Cameras stay on.
after.hinglish: Snack boxes Thursday subah pahunch gaye. Camera on rahe.

text.en: Skip snacks this time
text.hinglish: Is baar snacks chhod dein

after.en: The call runs without snacks. It ends on time.
after.hinglish: Call bina snacks ke chali. Samay par khatam hui.

text.en: Pay back anything people buy
text.hinglish: Jo bhi log khareedein, uska paisa lautayein

after.en: Twelve receipts arrive by Friday, and accounts asks about each one.
after.hinglish: Friday tak baarah receipts aa gayi, aur accounts har ek ke baare mein pooch raha hai.

scene.en: The scanner maker offers 6 training days on the new handheld scanners.
scene.hinglish: Scanner company naye handheld scanners par 6 training din de rahi hai.

question.en: Share the 6 training days.
question.hinglish: 6 training din baantiye.

text.en: Will set up the scanners on the packing line; the training fits that job.
text.hinglish: Packing line par scanners lagane ka kaam; training usi kaam ke liye.

text.en: Trains new pickers every month; will pass the training on.
text.hinglish: Har mahine naye pickers ko training; yeh training aage sikhayi jaayegi.

text.en: Works in the office and rarely uses scanners.
text.hinglish: Office mein kaam; scanners ka istemaal kam.

3.en: {name} took the most training days and starts on the packing line.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada training din {name} ko mile; packing line se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most training days and starts in the office.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada training din {name} ko mile; office se shuru.

even.en: The training days were shared evenly. Three colleagues know the new scanners.
even.hinglish: Training din barabar baante gaye. Teen colleagues naye scanners jaante hain.

scene.en: Lotus Home wants someone to walk the warehouse floor with them.
scene.hinglish: Lotus Home chahta hai ki koi unke saath warehouse floor ghoome.

question.en: Who should lead the floor walk? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Floor walk kaun lead karega? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Led client floor walks for four peak seasons; spots bottlenecks early.
text.hinglish: Chaar peak seasons mein client floor walks lead kiye; rukawatein jaldi pakadne mein achha.

text.en: Planned the current shelf layout; knows how stock moves through the floor.
text.hinglish: Abhi ka shelf layout plan kiya; floor par stock kaise chalta hai, achhi tarah pata.

text.en: Has joined one floor walk as a note taker.
text.hinglish: Ek floor walk mein note taker ke roop mein shaamil.

text.en: Mostly works on the budget side; has not walked the floor with a client.
text.hinglish: Zyaadatar budget ka kaam; client ke saath floor walk nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} walked the floor with the client, starting at the dock.
3.hinglish: {name} ne client ke saath floor walk kiya, dock se shuru.

1.en: {name} walked the floor with the client, starting at the shelves.
1.hinglish: {name} ne client ke saath floor walk kiya, shelves se shuru.

scene.en: Forty temporary pickers apply in one week, and the interview panel needs a lead.
scene.hinglish: Ek hafte mein chaalis temporary pickers apply karte hain, aur interview panel ko ek lead chahiye.

question.en: Who should lead the interview panel? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Interview panel kaun lead karega? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Led the interview panel for the last two peaks; most hires stayed the whole season.
text.hinglish: Pichhle do peaks mein interview panel lead kiya; zyaadatar log poore season ruke.

text.en: Trained as an interviewer last year and runs the warehouse's skills tests.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal interviewer ki training li; warehouse ke skills tests chalane ka kaam.

text.en: Has sat on one panel as an observer.
text.hinglish: Ek panel mein observer ke roop mein baithe hain.

text.en: Has not interviewed anyone for the warehouse.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ke liye kisi ka interview nahin liya.

3.en: {name} leads the panel, which asks about past peaks first.
3.hinglish: Panel {name} lead karenge, jo pehle purane peaks ke baare mein poochhta hai.

1.en: {name} leads the panel, which asks about safety first.
1.hinglish: Panel {name} lead karenge, jo pehle safety ke baare mein poochhta hai.

scene.en: Four outside applicants want the temporary shift supervisor job.
scene.hinglish: Chaar bahari applicants temporary shift supervisor ki naukri chahte hain.

question.en: Who should get the supervisor job? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Supervisor ki naukri kise milni chahiye? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Supervised a forty-person shift at a parcel hub for two peaks.
text.hinglish: Ek parcel hub par do peaks tak chaalis logon ki shift supervise ki.

text.en: Ran the night shift at a cold store for three years.
text.hinglish: Teen saal ek cold store ki night shift chalayi.

text.en: Has worked as a picker for one season.
text.hinglish: Ek season picker ka kaam kiya.

text.en: Comes from retail; new to warehouse shifts.
text.hinglish: Retail se aaye hain; warehouse shifts mein naye.

3.en: {name} starts on Monday and asks for the shift plan in writing.
3.hinglish: {name} Monday se shuru karenge aur shift plan likhit mein maangte hain.

1.en: {name} starts on Monday and asks to shadow a shift first.
1.hinglish: {name} Monday se shuru karenge aur pehle ek shift dekhna chahte hain.

scene.en: A first aid course has 6 places, and places can be split over two sessions.
scene.hinglish: First aid course mein 6 jagah hain, jo do sessions mein baanti ja sakti hain.

question.en: Share the 6 course places.
question.hinglish: 6 course jagah baantiye.

text.en: Will be the first aider on the night shift.
text.hinglish: Night shift ke first aider honge.

text.en: Will be the first aider on the loading dock.
text.hinglish: Loading dock ke first aider honge.

text.en: Has no first aid role planned.
text.hinglish: Koi first aid role tay nahin.

3.en: {name} took the most places and will cover the night shift.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada jagah {name} ko mili; night shift cover karenge.

1.en: {name} took the most places and will cover the office.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada jagah {name} ko mili; office cover karenge.

even.en: The places were shared evenly. Three first aiders cover the site.
even.hinglish: Jagah barabar baanti gayi. Teen first aiders site cover karte hain.

scene.en: Sale week needs 40 temporary pickers, trained and on a rota.
scene.hinglish: Sale week ke liye 40 temporary pickers chahiye, training aur rota ke saath.

question.en: Who should run the temp staff plan? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Temp staff plan kaun chalayega? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Recruited 30 temporary staff last peak and set up the rota; nobody missed a shift.
text.hinglish: Pichhle peak mein 30 temporary staff rakhe aur rota banaya; kisi ki shift nahin chhooti.

text.en: Runs the warehouse's training programme; has trained 200 new pickers.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ka training programme chalane ka kaam; 200 naye pickers ko training di.

text.en: Has helped on the induction desk once.
text.hinglish: Ek baar induction desk par madad ki.

text.en: Good with schedules in general; has not worked with temporary staff.
text.hinglish: Schedules mein aam taur par achha; temporary staff ke saath kaam nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} opened the temp rota, sorted by shift.
3.hinglish: {name} ne temp rota khola, shift ke hisaab se.

1.en: {name} opened the temp rota, sorted by zone.
1.hinglish: {name} ne temp rota khola, zone ke hisaab se.

scene.en: Four applicants want the two forklift driver places.
scene.hinglish: Chaar applicants do forklift driver jagahon ke liye aaye hain.

question.en: Who should drive for the peak? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Peak ke liye kaun chalayega? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Holds a forklift licence and five years at a port warehouse.
text.hinglish: Forklift licence hai aur port warehouse mein paanch saal.

text.en: Holds a forklift licence and drove for a cement depot for four years.
text.hinglish: Forklift licence hai aur chaar saal cement depot par chalaya.

text.en: Licence due next month; has driven a pallet truck.
text.hinglish: Licence agle mahine; pallet truck chalaya hai.

text.en: Has watched forklift training; no licence yet.
text.hinglish: Forklift training dekhi hai; abhi licence nahin.

3.en: {name} takes the first forklift and asks for the dock layout.
3.hinglish: {name} pehla forklift lete hain aur dock layout maangte hain.

1.en: {name} takes the first forklift and asks for a day of practice runs.
1.hinglish: {name} pehla forklift lete hain aur ek din practice maangte hain.

scene.en: Two temporary pickers each say a supervisor shouted at them on the floor.
scene.hinglish: Do temporary pickers kehte hain ki floor par ek supervisor unpar chillaya.

question.en: Whose complaint do you take up first?
question.hinglish: Pehle kiski shikayat uthaate hain?

text.en: Gives the date, the bay and a colleague who heard it.
text.hinglish: Tareekh, bay aur sunne wale colleague ka naam dete hain.

text.en: Gives the date, the time and a colleague who saw it.
text.hinglish: Tareekh, samay aur dekhne wale colleague ka naam dete hain.

2.en: You start with {name}'s complaint. The supervisor is asked for an account by Friday.
2.hinglish: Aap {name} ki shikayat se shuru karte hain. Supervisor se Friday tak bayaan maanga jaata hai.

scene.en: Twelve suppliers need peak contracts this week.
scene.hinglish: Is hafte baarah suppliers ke peak contracts karne hain.

question.en: Who should lead the supplier deals? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Supplier deals kaun lead karega? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Negotiated last peak's supplier contracts and saved 15 per cent.
text.hinglish: Pichhle peak ke supplier contracts tay kiye aur 15 pratishat bachaya.

text.en: Manages the warehouse's supplier list; has worked with eight of the twelve.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ki supplier list sambhalne ka kaam; baarah mein se aath ke saath kaam kiya.

text.en: Has sat in on two supplier meetings.
text.hinglish: Do supplier meetings mein baithe hain.

text.en: Strong on paperwork; has not negotiated a contract.
text.hinglish: Kaagzi kaam mein mazboot; koi contract tay nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} starts the supplier deals with the box makers.
3.hinglish: {name} supplier deals box banane walon se shuru karte hain.

1.en: {name} starts the supplier deals with the pallet yard.
1.hinglish: {name} supplier deals pallet yard se shuru karte hain.

scene.en: The client asks for a stock count on a Saturday.
scene.hinglish: Client Saturday ko stock count chahta hai.

question.en: What about the Saturday count?
question.hinglish: Saturday count ka kya karein?

text.en: Hold it, and give the team a day off in lieu
text.hinglish: Count karein, aur team ko badle mein ek din ki chhutti dein

after.en: The Saturday count goes ahead. Monday is a quiet day off.
after.hinglish: Saturday count ho gaya. Monday aaraam ki chhutti hai.

text.en: Move it to a weekday evening
text.hinglish: Ise kisi weekday ki shaam par le jaayein

after.en: The count moves to Wednesday evening. Two people join late.
after.hinglish: Count Wednesday shaam ko hua. Do log der se jude.

text.en: Hold it with no day off
text.hinglish: Count karein, koi chhutti nahin

after.en: The count goes ahead. The team is tired on Monday.
after.hinglish: Count ho gaya. Monday ko team thaki hui hai.

scene.en: Four applicants want the returns clerk job.
scene.hinglish: Chaar applicants returns clerk ki naukri chahte hain.

question.en: Who should be the returns clerk? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Returns clerk kaun bane? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Handled returns for an online fashion seller for two years.
text.hinglish: Do saal ek online fashion seller ke returns sambhale.

text.en: Ran the customer returns counter at an electronics store.
text.hinglish: Ek electronics store ka returns counter chalaya.

text.en: Has done data entry; no returns work.
text.hinglish: Data entry kiya hai; returns ka kaam nahin.

text.en: Has worked in a shop; no returns work.
text.hinglish: Dukaan mein kaam kiya hai; returns ka kaam nahin.

3.en: {name} sets up the returns desk by the east door.
3.hinglish: {name} returns desk east door ke paas lagate hain.

1.en: {name} sets up the returns desk by the loading bay.
1.hinglish: {name} returns desk loading bay ke paas lagate hain.

scene.en: Someone has to stay late for 6 evening stock checks. Nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: 6 shaam ke stock checks ke liye kisi ko der tak rukna hai. Yeh koi nahin maangta.

question.en: Share the 6 stock checks.
question.hinglish: 6 stock checks baantiye.

text.en: Has no evening commitments this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine shaam ko koi zimmedaari nahin.

text.en: Works a late start this month and is on site in the evenings.
text.hinglish: Is mahine der se shuru karte hain aur shaam ko site par hain.

text.en: Leaves early three days a week this month for a course.
text.hinglish: Is mahine course ke liye hafte mein teen din jaldi jaate hain.

3.en: {name} took the most checks. The counts start at six.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada checks {name} ke paas. Ginti chhah baje shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most checks. The counts start at seven.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada checks {name} ke paas. Ginti saat baje shuru.

even.en: The checks were shared evenly. Each person stays late twice.
even.hinglish: Checks barabar baante gaye. Har vyakti do baar der tak rukta hai.

scene.en: Two colleagues each say the other changed the rota without asking.
scene.hinglish: Do colleagues kehte hain ki doosre ne bina poochhe rota badla.

question.en: Whose account do you take first?
question.hinglish: Pehle kiska bayaan lete hain?

text.en: Has the rota as it was on Monday, saved from the team chat.
text.hinglish: Monday wala rota hai, team chat se save kiya.

text.en: Has the rota as it was on Monday, printed from the shared drive.
text.hinglish: Monday wala rota hai, shared drive se print kiya.

2.en: You take {name}'s account first. Rota changes now need two names.
2.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} ka bayaan lete hain. Ab rota badalne ke liye do naam chahiye.

scene.en: The peak budget needs one owner.
scene.hinglish: Peak budget ka ek owner chahiye.

question.en: Who should own the budget sheet?
question.hinglish: Budget sheet kaun sambhalega?

text.en: Kept last year's peak budget within one per cent of plan.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal ka peak budget plan ke ek pratishat ke andar rakha.

text.en: Runs the warehouse's monthly cost reports; spots overspends early.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ki monthly cost reports ka kaam; zyada kharch jaldi pakadne mein achha.

2.en: {name} owns the budget sheet now. The first version is shared with the client.
2.hinglish: Budget sheet ab {name} ke paas hai. Pehla version client ko bheja gaya.

scene.en: Two complaints reach you on Monday, each saying a colleague took credit for their work.
scene.hinglish: Monday ko do shikayatein aati hain, dono mein kaha gaya ki kisi colleague ne unke kaam ka credit le liya.

question.en: Whose complaint do you take up first?
question.hinglish: Aap pehle kiski shikayat uthaate hain?

text.en: Says the new shift rota was presented as someone else's work; has the dated draft.
text.hinglish: Kehte hain ki naya shift rota kisi aur ke kaam ke roop mein dikhaya gaya; date wala draft hai.

text.en: Says the returns fix was claimed by someone else on the client call; has the emails.
text.hinglish: Kehte hain ki client call par returns fix ka credit kisi aur ne liya; emails hain.

2.en: You start with {name}'s complaint. Both complaints are looked into by the end of the week.
2.hinglish: Aap {name} ki shikayat se shuru karte hain. Hafte ke aakhir tak dono shikayaton ki jaanch ho jaati hai.

scene.en: There was a shouting match on the loading dock. Four colleagues give you their account.
scene.hinglish: Loading dock par zor ki bahas hui. Chaar colleagues apna bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Aap kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Was on the dock throughout and wrote down what happened the same hour.
text.hinglish: Poore samay dock par the aur usi ghante likh liya ki kya hua.

text.en: Was loading the next truck, saw all of it, and gave the same account twice.
text.hinglish: Agla truck load kar rahe the, sab dekha, aur do baar ek jaisa bayaan diya.

text.en: Arrived at the end and heard the rest from others.
text.hinglish: Aakhir mein pahunche aur baaki doosron se suna.

text.en: Was on a break and heard it from the canteen.
text.hinglish: Break par the aur canteen se suna.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the dock review, which starts from the shift logs.
3.hinglish: Dock review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, shift logs se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the dock review, which starts from what people remember.
1.hinglish: Dock review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, logon ki yaad se.

scene.en: Two colleagues raise the same concern: overtime hours were left off their pay slips.
scene.hinglish: Do colleagues ek hi chinta uthaate hain: overtime ke ghante pay slip mein nahin jude.

question.en: Whose concern goes to payroll first?
question.hinglish: Kiski chinta pehle payroll ko jaayegi?

text.en: Kept a daily log of hours that matches the gate records.
text.hinglish: Ghanton ka roz ka log rakha jo gate records se milta hai.

text.en: Has the shift lead's signed overtime sheet for each day.
text.hinglish: Har din ki shift lead ki sign ki hui overtime sheet hai.

2.en: {name}'s concern goes first. Payroll fixes both pay slips this month.
2.hinglish: {name} ki chinta pehle gayi. Payroll ne is mahine dono pay slips theek kar di.

scene.en: The team asks how concerns should be raised from now on.
scene.hinglish: Team poochhti hai ki ab se chintaayein kaise uthaayi jaayein.

question.en: How should concerns be raised?
question.hinglish: Chintaayein kaise uthaayi jaayein?

text.en: A simple form, with a reply within a week
text.hinglish: Ek seedha form, ek hafte mein jawab ke saath

after.en: The form goes up on the notice board.
after.hinglish: Form notice board par lag gaya.

text.en: Come and see me any time
text.hinglish: Kabhi bhi mujhse mil lijiye

after.en: Two people come by. Others say they are not sure it is welcome.
after.hinglish: Do log aaye. Baaki kehte hain unhe pakka nahin ki yeh theek rahega.

text.en: Raise it at the weekly meeting, in front of everyone
text.hinglish: Weekly meeting mein sabke saamne uthaiye

after.en: Nobody raises anything at the weekly meeting.
after.hinglish: Weekly meeting mein koi kuch nahin uthaata.

scene.en: Two colleagues each ask for a quiet word: they are often spoken over in shift meetings.
scene.hinglish: Do colleagues alag alag baat karna chahte hain: shift meetings mein unki baat aksar kaati jaati hai.

question.en: You have time for one this week. Who do you meet first?
question.hinglish: Is hafte ek ke liye samay hai. Pehle kisse milenge?

text.en: Gives three recent examples, with the meeting dates.
text.hinglish: Haal ke teen udaharan dete hain, meeting ki tareekhon ke saath.

text.en: Gives three recent examples, and a colleague confirms each one.
text.hinglish: Haal ke teen udaharan dete hain, aur ek colleague unki pushti karta hai.

2.en: You meet {name} first. Shift meetings get a round where everyone speaks once.
2.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} se milte hain. Shift meetings mein ab har koi ek baar bolta hai.

scene.en: A pallet fell in aisle 9. Nobody was hurt. Four colleagues give an account.
scene.hinglish: Aisle 9 mein ek pallet gira. Kisi ko chot nahin aayi. Chaar colleagues bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most? Put them in order.
question.hinglish: Kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge? Inhe order mein rakhiye.

text.en: Was in aisle 9 and photographed the rack straight after.
text.hinglish: Aisle 9 mein the aur turant rack ka photo liya.

text.en: Was driving past, saw it fall and logged it within the hour.
text.hinglish: Paas se guzar rahe the, girte dekha aur ghante bhar mein log kiya.

text.en: Heard the noise from the next aisle.
text.hinglish: Agle aisle se aawaaz suni.

text.en: Heard about it at lunch.
text.hinglish: Lunch par suna.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the pallet review, which starts from the written records.
3.hinglish: Pallet review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, likhe records se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the pallet review, which starts from what people remember.

debrief.en: The season measured attitudes towards sex, and also towards religion, skin tone, caste and place of birth, through decisions about colleagues whose notes for a job were equally strong.

debrief.en: After you submit, you see your own attitude rating, read from this season's decisions only. It is shown to you alone, and it is stored only if you save it to an optional profile.

debrief.en: If anything here brings up a real situation at work, you can contact your Internal Committee, your district's Local Committee, or the SHe-Box portal.

consent.hinglish: Aakhir mein aap apne decisions se padhi gayi attitude rating dekhte hain. Yeh sirf aapko dikhti hai, aur aap chahein to ise apne banaye naam wali ek vaikalpik profile mein save kar sakte hain. Aapke jawabon mein na asli naam hai na contact.

consent.en: At the end you receive a withdrawal code. After all play in the study closes, a page explaining the study opens with that code, and you can withdraw with it until two weeks after the page opens.

consent.en: Taking part is voluntary, and you can stop at any time.

body.en: When a woman and a man had equally strong notes for a job, you put {group} ahead more often than chance would explain. The pull was small in any one decision; it shows across the season as a whole. That is common: most people's decisions lean one way on some ground, and many never find out. Knowing where yours leaned is the useful part. This reads one season of a made-up warehouse, so treat it as a reading, not a verdict on who you are.
body.hinglish: Jab ek mahila aur ek purush ke kaam ke notes barabar mazboot the, aapne {group} ko itni baar aage rakha jitna sanyog se nahin samjhaya ja sakta. Kisi ek decision mein kheench chhoti thi; yeh poore season mein dikhti hai. Yeh aam baat hai: zyaadatar logon ke decisions kisi aadhaar par ek taraf jhukte hain, aur kai log yeh kabhi nahin jaan paate. Apna jhukaav jaanna hi kaam ki baat hai. Yeh ek kaalpanik warehouse ke ek season ki reading hai, aap kaun hain is par faisla nahin.

body.en: When a woman and a man had equally strong notes for a job, you put each of them ahead about as often as chance would. That is an absence of evidence from about 50 decisions, not a clean bill: a lean too small for one short season to pick up could still be there, and another setting could read differently. Everyone's decisions lean somewhere, so the habits below are worth keeping either way.
body.hinglish: Jab ek mahila aur ek purush ke kaam ke notes barabar mazboot the, aapne dono ko lagbhag utni hi baar aage rakha jitna sanyog se hota. Yeh lagbhag 50 decisions mein saboot ki kami hai, saaf certificate nahin: itna chhota jhukaav ho sakta hai jo ek chhota season na pakad sake, aur kisi aur maahaul mein reading alag ho sakti hai. Har kisi ke decisions kahin na kahin jhukte hain, isliye neeche ki aadatein dono haalat mein kaam ki hain.

body.en: This season does not hold enough decisions of the right kind to read a lean either way. That says nothing about you; it is a limit of one short season.

watch.hinglish: Kuch baantne se pehle har hisse ke aage uski wajah likhiye.

contactBody.en: Both fields are optional and are kept apart from your answers and from any profile. Leave them empty to skip.
contactBody.hinglish: Dono fields vaikalpik hain aur aapke jawabon aur kisi bhi profile se alag rakhe jaate hain. Chhodna ho to khaali rakhiye.

contactFollow.en: Send me follow-up material and retake reminders
contactFollow.hinglish: Mujhe follow-up material aur retake reminders bhejiye

contactResearch.en: I agree to be contacted for longitudinal research
contactResearch.hinglish: Main lambi research ke liye sampark kiye jaane par sehmat hoon

contactSent.en: Thank you. Your details are kept apart from your answers.
contactSent.hinglish: Shukriya. Aapki details aapke jawabon se alag rakhi gayi hain.

contactNeedEmail.en: Add an email for either box, or untick it.
contactNeedEmail.hinglish: Kisi bhi box ke liye email jodiye, ya tick hata dijiye.

contactFailed.en: Your details could not be sent. Try again.
contactFailed.hinglish: Aapki details bheji nahin ja saki. Dobara koshish kijiye.

domainReading.en: Women and men in this area: {zone}
domainReading.hinglish: Is kshetra mein mahila aur purush: {zone}

_devPending.en: Demo: the thresholds behind every reading are planning values, PENDING v18.
_devPending.hinglish: Demo: har reading ke peeche ki seemaayein planning values hain, PENDING v18.

rating._watchPending: PENDING v18: the sources for these habits.
rating._contactResearchPending: PENDING v18: the consent text for longitudinal contact.

heroLine.en: equal pairs where you put the {one} ahead
heroLine.hinglish: barabar jodiyan jahan aapne {one} ko aage rakha

heroDots.en: {n} equal pairs: {m} with the man ahead, shown filled; {e} with neither ahead, shown dashed; {w} with the woman ahead, shown as rings.
heroDots.hinglish: {n} barabar jodiyan: {m} mein purush aage, bhare hue; {e} mein koi aage nahin, dashed; {w} mein mahila aage, khaali gol.

areasTitle.hinglish: Aapke decisions, kshetra ke hisaab se

profile._note: The optional pseudonymous profile (EVAL-4, owner decision 19 Oct 2026: retakes are in). The longitudinal research consent and the change rule are PENDING v18.

saveTitle.hinglish: Ise rakhiye aur baad mein dobara kheliye

retake.en: Retake later to see how your decisions change. A retake is a different season with a new team.
retake.hinglish: Baad mein dobara kheliye aur dekhiye ki aapke decisions kaise badalte hain. Dobara khelna ek alag season hai, nayi team ke saath.

saveBody.en: Save this rating to a profile with any name you like. There is no email and no password: a recovery code opens it.
saveBody.hinglish: Is rating ko apni pasand ke kisi bhi naam wali profile mein save kijiye. Na email, na password: ek recovery code se profile khulti hai.

nameLabel.en: A display name (any name you like)

create.hinglish: Meri profile banayein aur save karein

saved.hinglish: {name} ki profile mein save ho gaya.

failed.en: The profile could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
failed.hinglish: Profile save nahin ho saki. Connection check karke dobara koshish kijiye.

recoveryBody.en: This code is the only way back into your profile: there is no email and no password. Write it down or take a screenshot. It is not your withdrawal code.
recoveryBody.hinglish: Yeh code hi aapki profile mein wapas aane ka akela raasta hai: na email, na password. Ise likh lijiye ya screenshot le lijiye. Yeh aapka withdrawal code nahin hai.

lockedBody.en: Enter your recovery code to open your profile.
lockedBody.hinglish: Apni profile kholne ke liye recovery code likhiye.

badCode.en: No profile opens with that code. Check it and try again.
badCode.hinglish: Is code se koi profile nahin khulti. Check karke dobara koshish kijiye.

demoNote.en: Demo: this profile's two past seasons are made up, in seasons that are not built yet, so the timeline can be seen.
demoNote.hinglish: Demo: is profile ke do purane season kaalpanik hain, un seasons mein jo abhi bane nahin, taaki timeline dikh sake.

noChange.hinglish: Abhi koi badlaav nahin padha gaya.

change.en: Change read: from {from} to {to}, your decisions moved towards {group}.
change.hinglish: Badlaav padha gaya: {from} se {to} tak, aapke decisions {group} ki taraf gaye.

retakeBody.en: A retake is a season you have not played, with a new team. In a study, your next link comes from the study team.
retakeBody.hinglish: Dobara khelna ek aisa season hai jo aapne nahin khela, nayi team ke saath. Study mein aapka agla link study team se aata hai.

noStoryLeft.en: Every season open to you has been played on this profile. The other seasons open later.
noStoryLeft.hinglish: Is profile par har khula season khela ja chuka hai. Baaki seasons baad mein khulenge.

researchConsent.en: If you agree, the study team may link the seasons saved on this profile, to study how decisions change over time. They still never learn your name or contact details.
researchConsent.hinglish: Agar aap sehmat hain, to study team is profile par save hue seasons ko jod sakti hai, yeh samajhne ke liye ki decisions samay ke saath kaise badalte hain. Unhe phir bhi aapka naam ya contact kabhi pata nahin chalta.

researchConsent.en: Without it, your saved seasons stay unlinked for research. You can turn this off at any time, and turning it off deletes the link.
researchConsent.hinglish: Iske bina, aapke save kiye seasons research ke liye alag hi rehte hain. Aap ise kabhi bhi band kar sakte hain, aur band karne se link mit jaata hai.

researchAgree.en: I agree to longitudinal research use of my saved seasons
researchAgree.hinglish: Main apne save kiye seasons ke lambe research mein istemaal ke liye sehmat hoon

researchOn.hinglish: Lambi research ka istemaal chalu hai.

researchOff.hinglish: Lambi research ka istemaal band hai.

deleteButton.en: Delete my profile and all my records
deleteButton.hinglish: Meri profile aur mere saare records mitaayein

deleteConfirm.en: This deletes your profile, its research link, and the records of every saved season still inside its withdrawal window. It cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.hinglish: Isse aapki profile, uska research link, aur har save kiye season ke records mit jaate hain jo abhi withdrawal window ke andar hain. Ise wapas nahin kiya ja sakta.

deleted.en: Your profile is deleted. Seasons withdrawn: {w}. Seasons past their withdrawal date, kept with nothing linking them to you: {c}.
deleted.hinglish: Aapki profile mit gayi. Withdraw hue seasons: {w}. Withdrawal date ke baad wale seasons, jo aapse bina kisi link ke rakhe gaye: {c}.

lock.en: Close my profile on this device
lock.hinglish: Is device par meri profile band karein

_devChangePending.en: Demo: the rule for reading a change is a planning value, PENDING v18.
_devChangePending.hinglish: Demo: badlaav padhne ka niyam ek planning value hai, PENDING v18.

profile._researchConsentPending: PENDING v18: this consent text is a draft for the owner and the ethics review.
